Distributor FAQ
Do you hold US stock?
No. Vocom is build-to-order with no US warehouse. Standard lead time is 6 to 8 weeks, expedited air freight is 2 to 3 weeks, and high-count or custom builds take up to 10 weeks.
Can you be a second source for specs my supplier is slow on?
Yes. Rollable ribbon, high-count, micro and indoor plenum cable are the specs most often quoted in months elsewhere. Send the spec and we return a price and a delivery date.
What should I send to get a quote?
Fiber count, fiber type, construction, jacket rating (OFNP, OFNR or LSZH), footage, needed-by date and destination. Any spec can be built to order as a custom build.
Can orders be split across ship dates?
Yes. Large orders are commonly split into tranches so cable arrives against your customers' build phases instead of sitting in your yard.
Where can I find catalog information?
The Resources page has our fiber optic cable catalog with counts, specs and how to order. For anything outside it, send the spec and we will quote it.
Need a Spec Your Supplier Cannot Fill?
Fiber count, jacket, rating and needed-by date, send it and we will quote it as a build-to-order.

What the ratings mean

OFNP is plenum rated, for air handling spaces. OFNR is riser rated, for vertical runs between floors. The rating follows the pathway and the authority inspecting the installation has the final say, so it belongs on the purchase order rather than being assumed.

Indoor fiber cable FAQ
What is the difference between OFNP and OFNR?

OFNP is plenum rated for air handling spaces. OFNR is riser rated for vertical runs between floors. Plenum is the stricter rating, and the inspecting authority decides which one applies to your pathway.
Which indoor cables do you supply?

Mini cable in 8F and 12F with 3.0mm OD and OFNP rating, indoor rollable ribbon from 12F to 864F in plenum and riser ratings, armored indoor drop, and MPO and MTP trunks and patch cords for the data hall.
Can you supply high-count indoor cable?
Yes. Indoor rollable ribbon runs from 12F to 864F with plenum and riser options, built to order. For other counts, send the spec and we will quote it as a custom build.

6 to 8 weeks from PO, 2 to 3 weeks expedited by air, and up to 10 weeks for custom builds.

Fiber count, fiber type, construction, rating (OFNP, OFNR or LSZH), outer diameter if the pathway is tight, footage and needed-by date.

Connectors and hardware FAQ
Which connector types do you supply?

LC, SC, FC, ST and MTRJ patch cords, in UPC or APC polish where the connector allows, plus MTP/MPO trunk and array cables, adapters for each connector type, cassette adapters, SC shutter connectors and OptiTap compatible hardened connectors.
What jacket ratings are available?

Patch cords are OFNR riser rated as standard, with OFNP plenum on LC and SC cords and LSZH on armored cords, LC uniboot cords and MTP/MPO array cables. Outdoor terminal boxes and hardened connectors are IP68 rated.
Do you have options for outdoor and tower sites?
Yes. IP68 waterproof terminal boxes in 2F to 12F for tower and FTTA sites, and OptiTap compatible hardened connectors (IP68, GR-3120, GR-326) for outdoor field termination.

6 to 8 weeks from PO, 2 to 3 weeks expedited by air, and up to 10 weeks for custom builds.

Connector type and polish at each end, fiber type, fiber count, jacket rating, length and quantity, plus polarity for MTP/MPO assemblies and your needed-by date.

pages.title: IEPL and IPLC Private Leased Circuits, Asia-Pacific | Vocom
pages.description: IEPL and IPLC private leased circuits on cross-Pacific and Asia-Pacific routes, from sub-1 Gbps to 10 Gbps and above, from a carrier founded in 1998.
texts: IEPL and IPLC Private Leased Circuits Across the Pacific

Dedicated point-to-point capacity between two fixed endpoints, reserved for you alone and never routed over the public internet. Vocom provisions IEPL and IPLC circuits on cross-Pacific and Asia-Pacific routes, sized from sub-1 Gbps access links up to 10 Gbps and above.
How to Order a Private Circuit
Two endpoints and a bandwidth figure are enough to start:
Step 1: Send Your Endpoints
The two locations, the bandwidth you need now, and where you expect it to be in three years.
Step 2: Get a Sized Route
An engineer returns the route, protection and latency for the path, not just a rate card.
Private capacity on a backbone we run, not resold transport:
Circuits and the Services Around Them
Everything a point-to-point build needs, from one carrier:
IEPL
International Ethernet Private Line: an Ethernet handoff on dedicated transport, scaled in Ethernet increments, often by a configuration change rather than a new circuit.
IPLC
International Private Leased Circuit on TDM over SDH or SONET, with guaranteed capacity, very low jitter and native E1 or T1 handoff for legacy equipment.
Local Loop
Local access into Vocom's PoPs for the last mile of a private circuit.
Protected Routes
Protected paths on major routes, including Hong Kong to Taipei, Singapore, Tokyo and Los Angeles, with estimated round-trip times quoted per route.
MPLS-VPN
An owned MPLS/VPLS backbone with direct cloud connectivity into AWS, Azure and Microsoft.
IP Transit and DIA
Local peering blended with global BGP across 20+ PoPs, including a dedicated China route by carrier.
The same NOC watches private circuits, IP transit and MPLS around the clock.
